evals.prompt: Watch this Loom and tell me what changed visually: https://www.loom.com/share/1c024b2b97f4432cabd749775a4726ec
evals.expected_output: The skill should run the bundled extractor, notice that captions/transcript are empty, inspect the sampled frames, and summarize the visible screen state without pretending there was narration.

evals.prompt: Can you review this Loom bug report and give me repro steps plus timestamps?
evals.expected_output: The skill should extract transcript and frames, read the manifest first, inspect frames around relevant cues, and report timestamped repro evidence plus any missing information.

evals.prompt: Please extract the transcript from this Loom, but also verify any 'this/that' references against the screen.
evals.expected_output: The skill should provide timestamped transcript text when available and cross-check deictic references against frames, rather than returning transcript text alone.

evals.prompt: This Loom is private and the extractor cannot access it. What should I do?
evals.expected_output: The skill should not try to bypass access controls. It should explain that private/password/SSO Looms need an accessible share link or user-provided transcript/screenshots.

evals.prompt: This Hebrew Loom says unsupported_language and has no transcript. Can you still understand what was said?
evals.expected_output: The skill should rerun the extractor with the explicit OpenAI fallback (`--openai-transcribe --language he`) when an API key is available, extract audio, generate a timestamped transcript, align it with frames in the manifest, and clearly report if the API key is missing.

evals.prompt: I don't want to use API credits for a Hebrew Loom. Can you use local Whisper instead?
evals.expected_output: The skill should prefer `--local-whisper --language he` when whisper.cpp and the local model are installed, extract Loom audio, consume the generated VTT output, rebuild the manifest, and report clearly if no local transcriber/model is installed. It may fall back to `--local-transcribe-command` for other open-source transcribers.
